sections.heading: Connected care. Smarter pharmaceutical operations.
sections.body:
Healthcare providers need connected patient administration and dependable service information; pharmaceutical teams need visibility across procurement, inventory and distribution. Linkfields combines integration, enterprise platforms and governed Data & AI with proprietary software and reusable workflow IP, keeping privacy and human oversight central.

The focus is administrative and business operations. Clinical decisions, medical devices, validated GxP systems and named health interoperability standards require separately confirmed scope and evidence.

sections.heading: What we deliver
sections.description: Inputs, human roles and access boundaries are agreed per workflow; administrative efficiency is not a claim about clinical outcomes.

items.title: Patient enquiries and appointments
items.description: Disconnected enquiry and appointment channels can leave administrative teams without a shared case view.
items.bullets:
Workflow – Connect service requests, appointment status and staff hand-offs.
Control – Staff own scheduling and escalation; agree permitted data and role-based access.
items.footText: Handoff completion, repeat enquiries and administrative cycle time.

items.title: Health application and data integration
items.description: Administrative applications need consistent data flows without broadening access to sensitive records.
items.bullets:
Workflow – Map interfaces, transform permitted data and route quality exceptions to system owners.
Control – Agree consent/access requirements, data boundaries and accountable source ownership.
items.footText: Interface reliability, data quality and exception resolution.

items.title: Pharma supply visibility
items.description: Procurement, inventory and distribution records can leave supply teams with different views of stock.
items.bullets:
Workflow – Connect purchase orders, stock movements and distribution status for exception review.
Control – Supply owners validate records and actions; agree access and data freshness.
items.footText: Inventory reconciliation, exception age and fulfilment visibility.

items.title: Controlled documents and approvals
items.description: Operational documents and approval queues need clear versions, access and reviewer accountability.
items.bullets:
Workflow – Use document intelligence to organise content and route operational approvals.
Control – Named reviewers approve changes; retain source references and decision records.
items.footText: Approval turnaround, rework and record completeness.

sections.heading: Software and accelerators for connected operations
sections.description: Selected capability fit, not proof of a provider or pharma deployment. Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without services.

items.title: Linkworks
items.description: Composable applications and APIs for administrative or supply workflows where the ERP or CRM does not fit.

items.title: textIQ
items.description: Search and insight across operational documents, with permitted sources and access boundaries agreed.

items.title: Intelligent Workflow Automation
items.description: Reusable routing, approvals and application integration tailored to operational review checkpoints.

items.title: testoriumz
items.description: Continuous software release assurance with low-code testing and CI/CD integration; not clinical or pharmaceutical product validation.

sections.heading: Which patient or supply workflow needs to connect?
sections.description: Example engagement pattern: a starting point for scoping, not a claim about a completed client deployment.

items.title: Frame the workflow
items.description: Select an administrative or pharmaceutical supply workflow and the staff responsible for it.
items.bullets:
Inputs – application map, permitted data flows and redacted process samples
Output – prioritised workflow and integration scope

items.title: Design controlled change
items.description: Agree consent and access requirements, human approval points and evidence needs with the responsible teams.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – interface map, access matrix and review checkpoints
Quality gate – agreed tests and exception handling

items.title: Agree acceptance and operation
items.description: Define an administrative or supply baseline, data-quality checks and acceptance measures. Any clinical, interoperability or pharma validation scope needs separate assessment.
items.bullets:
Artefacts – acceptance measures, release evidence and ownership plan
Commercial model – project, managed service or dedicated team

sections.note: We can agree an NDA before sharing confidential information. Describe the process and existing systems, not patient records or confidential pharmaceutical documents.
